schema.name: currency
schema.description: Retrieve exchange rates for multiple currencies based on a specific currency, the unit is 1. This function should only be used once to retrieve multiple currency exchange rates. If the user does not provide a currency type, please use cny as the base currency.

base_currency.description: The base currency, needs English lowercase. Default value is 'cny'

exchange_currencies.description: Currency names for which exchange rates need to be retrieved, English lowercase. Multiple currencies separated by |. Default value is 'usd|try|ngn'

prompt: Refine the results and calculate the accurate data.
